description: Header file defining the CopyPasteManager class with static methods and properties for clipboard operations and operand validation in a calculator app.

classes.name: CopyPasteMaxOperandLengthAndValue
classes.description: Struct holding maximum operand length and value.

classes.name: CopyPasteManager
classes.description: Sealed class providing static methods for clipboard and operand validation operations.

methods.name: CopyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies a string to the clipboard.

methods.name: GetStringToPaste
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a string to paste based on mode, type, number base, and bit length.

methods.name: HasStringToPaste
methods.description: Checks if there is a string available to paste.

methods.name: IsErrorMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message is an error message.

methods.name: GetMaxOperandLengthAndValue
methods.description: Returns maximum operand length and value based on mode, type, number base, and bit length.

methods.name: ExtractOperands
methods.description: Extracts operands from a pasted expression.

methods.name: ExpressionRegExMatch
methods.description: Checks if operands match expected expression pattern.

methods.name: RemoveUnwantedCharsFromString
methods.description: Removes unwanted characters from input string.

methods.name: TryOperandToULL
methods.description: Attempts to convert operand string to unsigned long long.

methods.name: StandardScientificOperandLength
methods.description: Calculates operand length for standard/scientific modes.

methods.name: OperandLength
methods.description: Calculates operand length based on mode, type, and number base.

methods.name: ProgrammerOperandLength
methods.description: Calculates operand length for programmer mode.
